mirror.heatmapHoverNote: Each square is a day; the darker it is, the more was learned that day.

mirror.trendsEmpty: Once learning starts, the lines appear here.
mirror.trendLayersMemoryNote: An estimate of how many concepts could still be recalled that day; without contact it fades over time.
mirror.trendLayersUnderstandingNote: The share of remembered concepts backed by your own explanation or by a statement that you had learned it. Also an estimate.
mirror.trendLayersIntuitionNote: The roughest estimate: the part that has been stable for a long time and has been used in conversation.
mirror.trendWordsSettledLabel: Words stable for over a month
mirror.trendWordsMemoryNote: An estimate of how many words could still be recalled that day; without contact it fades over time.
mirror.trendWordsIntuitionNote: The roughest estimate: words that have been stable for a long time and have been used in your own sentences.
mirror.trendWordsSettledNote: Counts words that have been stable for over a month. New words take time to settle, so a flat start at zero is normal.
